name: Destined Notes : The Written Fate
detailed_description:
Chapter 1 - Unsureness Of Answers


Overview:
Step into the shoes of Daniel, a paranormal investigator with the rare ability to witness the final moments of lost souls. When a brutal family massacre in a small Ohio town defies all logic, Daniel is called in to uncover the truth. What begins as a routine investigation soon spirals into a nightmarish journey filled with eerie apparitions, cryptic messages, and a dark force lurking in the shadows. As Daniel pieces together the chilling events, he is forced to confront his own past, leading to a terrifying discovery that will change everything.


Key Features:

  • Immersive Horror Narrative – Experience a deeply engaging story filled with suspense, mystery, and supernatural horror.

  • First-Person Investigative Gameplay – Search for hidden clues, solve intricate puzzles, and unravel the town’s darkest secrets.

  • Supernatural Abilities – Witness the past through paranormal visions and interact with the spirit world.

  • Cinematic Storytelling – High-quality cutscenes and voice-acted dialogue bring the horror to life.

  • Psychological Horror Elements – Encounter unsettling environments, eerie sounds, and disturbing entities that test your sanity.

  • Puzzle-Based Progression – Solve environmental puzzles, unlock hidden areas, and perform rituals to break the curse.

short_description: Unravel a chilling mystery as Daniel, a paranormal investigator with the ability to see the past of lost souls. Explore a haunted house, solve cryptic puzzles, and confront a sinister force that lingers within. Will you uncover the truth, or become part of the legend?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 / Intel Core i7 6700K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 580 with 6GB VRAM ／ NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 Ti with 6GB VRAM
  • Additional Notes: Playing on minimum requirements should enable to play on Low/Medium quality settings in FullHD (1080p) in stable 30 FPS in performance mode. SSD Required. The above specifications were tested with DLSS.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64 bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5500 ／ Intel Core i7 9700
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT with 8 GB VRAM／ NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 with 8 GB VRAM / INTEL Arc A750 with 8 GB VRAM
  • Additional Notes: Playing on recommended requirements should enable to play on Medium quality settings in 60 FPS in Performance mode or High quality settings in 30 FPS, in FullHD. SSD Required. The above specifications were tested with DLSS.

content_descriptors.notes: The Destined Note is a psychological horror experience designed for mature audiences. It features intense and unsettling scenes that may not be suitable for all players. Those sensitive to violence, psychological trauma, or supernatural horror should proceed with caution.
